source: Door markers painted on GroundZero.svg rasters, colored by the key from json.tarkov.dev ground-zero locks. GroundZero.svg has no locked-room fills. Six locks are published; the Factory emergency exit key at x=264.95 is outside the frame and is not drawn. The same five markers apply to ground-zero-21.

entries.name: Parking utility
entries.tip: Underground parking utility room key. Orange door marker on the underground floor.

entries.name: Factory exit
entries.tip: Factory emergency exit key. Red marker in the underground garage. A second lock at x=264.95 is outside the frame and is not drawn.

entries.name: Bank register
entries.tip: Unity Credit Bank cash register key. Blue door marker on the ground floor.

entries.name: Horse toilet
entries.tip: Horse restaurant toilet key. Green door marker on the ground floor.

entries.name: Science office
entries.tip: TerraGroup science office key. Violet door marker on the second floor.
